text:
maria: Heads up — seeing a steady trickle of tiny GPU pods stuck Pending in us-west1 after last night's slot-reservoir rollout. Also a spike in evictions ~02:10-02:40 UTC. Anyone still on the rollout?

tyler: I'm still on the canary, but I haven't seen user-facing failures. Can you paste `kubectl get pods -n training -o wide` for one of the affected jobs?

maria: quick snippet — most are Pending with `0/4 nodes` type messages and taint mismatch.

```
NAME                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
train-small-abc123           0/1     Pending   0          6m   <none>
train-tiny-def456            0/1     Pending   0          5m   <none>
```

jess: we switched the `slot-reservoir` taint key to `gpu-reserve=true:NoSchedule` on the new warm-pool nodes. That was supposed to only affect the warm pool, but looks like node-label propagation didn't finish before autoscaler placed new preemptible nodes.

maria: logs from scheduler showing reject reason: `FailedScheduling: node(s) had taint {gpu-reserve=true:NoSchedule}` even though pods don't request that class.

```
I0319 02:13:11.123 scheduler.go:512] Pod train-small-abc123 rejected: node gpu-node-03 has taint gpu-reserve=true:NoSchedule
I0319 02:13:12.420 scheduler.go:512] Binding failed: no compatible node found
```

ash: @jess did the rollout include the label/taint order fix? We patched a similar issue before where kubelet applied taints sooner than labels, causing affinity rules to mis-evaluate.

jess: we intentionally applied taints first to avoid immediate evictions on warm nodes, but maybe that backfired — some pods with `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` affinity were treated as hard constraints by scheduler heuristics.

tyler: can we temporarily relax the taint to `PreferNoSchedule` and let scheduler rebalance, or is that a no-go for cost isolation?

sre-lead: relaxing to PreferNoSchedule should be safe for a quick mitigation (we'll lose some warm-pool isolation). Let's do that for the affected AZs while we rollback ordering.

maria: +1. If we don't act, small training jobs backfill on the on-demand pool and we hit cost alarms. We're already seeing SLO noise in the cost dashboard.

ops-bot: ALERT: us-west1 GPU cost anomaly — +28% spend vs hourly baseline (02:00-03:00 UTC). Related to pod spillover and preemptible fallback.

infra-bot: Deploy event: `canary/slot-reservoir v2.3` started 2026-03-19T01:45:02Z by jess.

jess: Plan: 1) patch taint -> PreferNoSchedule for us-west1 AZs (quick); 2) revert to label-first rollout and redeploy canary; 3) run a small job sweep to confirm Pending -> Running. Anyone object?

ash: I can flip the taint mode in the live patch and monitor. Will run smoke test 10m after.

tyler: after the patch, I can run `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` on one warm-node to verify pods land correctly (non-destructive for warm pool).

maria: can we also add a quick scheduler metric: `scheduler_predicate_taint_mismatch` to grafana for the next 24h? Would help root cause.

sre-lead: Good idea, add an alert if that metric spikes >5/min for 10m. I'll create the alert.

jess: Patch applied to us-west1a/b/c: taint mode switched to PreferNoSchedule. Rolling watch.

ash: initial confirmation: within 3m we saw 12 Pending -> Running transitions. No immediate cost surge yet.

maria: thanks team. Let's keep the canary paused until label-order fix is in. Also adding a note: pods using `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` with co-located affinity may be treated by the scheduler as stricter when combined with taints — file for scheduler-team follow-up.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — us-west1 pod pending rate normalized. Continued monitoring for 2 hours.

infra-bot: Rollback scheduled: `slot-reservoir v2.3` paused at 02:20 UTC pending label-order fix.

tyler: follow-up: we should add a simple e2e that deploys a tiny GPU pod while taints/labels propagate to avoid this drift in future. I'll open a PR.

jess: +1 on the test, and I'll document the rollout checklist (apply labels before taints unless the change requires a different ordering).

maria: thanks all — keeping an eye on cost dashboard & pending pods. Ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
